summary: PearlThoughts is looking for motivated and curious AI Engineer Interns to join their growing remote team. This role is ideal for freshers or early-stage engineers who want hands-on exposure to RAG pipelines, code intelligence, AI agents, and legacy system modernization.
responsibilities: Assist in building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines for code and documentation
Work on semantic search and vector embeddings for intelligent retrieval
Support development of AI agents for code analysis and migration tasks
Help design and maintain knowledge graphs for understanding code relationships
Work with LLMs (GPT, Claude, LLaMA) for code generation and reasoning
Parse and analyze source code using tools like tree-sitter
Collaborate with engineers to improve AI-driven automation and developer tooling
required_skills: Basic to intermediate knowledge of Python or JavaScript/TypeScript
Understanding of embeddings, vector search, and semantic similarity
Familiarity with LLMs and prompt engineering concepts
Basic knowledge of SQL and data structures
Interest in compilers, code analysis, or developer tools
nice_to_have_skills: Exposure to FastAPI, NestJS, or similar frameworks
Awareness of vector databases (LanceDB, Pinecone, Weaviate, etc.)
benefits: Growth Path: High-performing interns may be offered a paid internship or full-time opportunity
